lines.text: The cards already told me how this ends, darling. Not well for you.
I see your future. It is very, very short.
The cards called this one before you walked in, sugar.
I see a long rest in your future. Starting now.
Your reading is over, baby. Somebody else is on hold.
Card tricks? Child, my cards tell the future.
You study the stars, honey. I read them.
